title: fix(console): ask /auth/me/permissions in the organization/list wave when the session names the active organization
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbUWr9d2gZLZYRsHs8B5b317)_

Fixes #29114

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：打开 Console 首页或任一应用时，`/auth/me/permissions` 不再排在 `organization/list` 之后才发，而是在会话答复里已带活动组织时立刻发出，与组织列表同一波；组织闸门、`/me/apps` 与页面本身照旧等组织选定。`@object-ui/permissions` 为此新增一个"先发请求、Provider 只取一次"的接口。
- **为什么改**：权限答复决定导航和按钮能不能画出来，以前它白等一整波（组织列表，以及元数据外壳的 discovery），之后的整层请求也跟着晚一波；服务端本来就按会话里的活动组织作答，没有必要等。
- **风险与回滚**：低。请求总数不变（实测两边都是 20/19/19 个 API 请求、0 个重复 URL）；会话没有活动组织时走原来的顺序；先发的请求只被同一用户+同一组织的 Provider 取用一次，离开路由即丢弃，不是缓存。唯一代价：会话里的组织若不在组织列表里（陈旧会话），会多出一个没人读的权限请求，随后照旧跳转 `/organizations`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx` 的 held request（取用、释放、StrictMode 重放）；② `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` 的 `ConsolePermissionsRequest` 与 `requestKey`；③ `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` 布局路由里新增的一个兄弟元素。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.permissionsWave-29114.test.tsx packages/permissions/src/__tests__/MePermissionsProvider.heldRequest-29114.test.tsx`，预期 13 个测试全绿（权限请求在组织列表与 discovery 都未答复时已发出，且全程只有一次）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`/auth/me/permissions` now leaves in the same wave as `organization/list` when the `get-session` answer already names the active organization. The server answers that endpoint for the session's active organization (`resolveAuthzContext` reads `session.activeOrganizationId`, never a header), so the id in the session answer settles which answer comes back.

**Why it was late.** The Console's one permissions provider (`ConsolePermissionsScope`, mounted by `App.tsx` on the pathless `/home` + `/apps` layout route) renders under `ProtectedRoute`, whose `ConnectedShell` renders nothing until the adapter's `/discovery` answers, and whose `RequireOrganization` renders nothing until `organization/list` answers. Both leave when the session answer lands, so the permissions request left one wave late, and everything after it (`meta/*`, `/me/apps`, the page) one wave later. Moving only the organization gate is not enough: measured, the request then waits on `/discovery` instead, which is in the same wave (see Acceptance notes).

**`@object-ui/permissions` (public additions, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`):**

- `startMePermissionsRequest({ endpoint, fetcher, key })` asks now and holds the request with the endpoint and the identity (`key`) it was asked for. It must be public because the caller is the Console's route, which mounts long before the provider; nothing inside the package can see the session answer.
- `MePermissionsProviderProps.requestKey?: string` (optional). When a held request matches the provider's endpoint and key, the provider uses it as its first attempt instead of asking again; it is gone once that provider has its answer. A take for any other endpoint or key drops it. Without `requestKey` the provider behaves exactly as before. It must be public because the provider is the package's public component and the key is the only way a caller can say which question the held answer is for.
- `releaseMePermissionsRequest(endpoint, key)` says the caller no longer needs the answer (the route was left, or the session names another organization). The request is dropped on the next task unless asked for again by then. It must be public so the caller that started the request can end it; without it a request nobody took would stay held and could later be read as a stale answer.
- `StartMePermissionsRequestOptions` is the options type of the first function.
- Both ends survive a React StrictMode replay: a replayed starter (start, release, start) asks once, and a provider whose effect is torn down before it used the answer leaves it held for its replay. Not a cache: the answer is used for the moment it was asked in.

**Console (`ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, `App.tsx`):**

- `ConsolePermissionsRequest` (renders nothing) asks for the answer the moment the session names the active organization, keyed `user.id:activeOrganizationId`, and releases it on unmount or key change. `App.tsx` renders it beside `ProtectedRoute` in the `/home` + `/apps` layout route element (the one line in `App.tsx`).
- `ConsolePermissionsScope` passes the same key as `requestKey`, so its provider takes that request. Its position, the organization gate above it, `/me/apps` and every page are unchanged.
- A session that names no organization asks nothing early: the organization pipeline may still activate one (the single-membership repair) or redirect to `/organizations`, and the provider asks after the gate, as before.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.permissionsWave-29114.test.tsx` (4 tests), the real `App` route tree, real `ProtectedRoute`, real `RequireOrganization`, real `ConsolePermissionsScope`, `MePermissionsProvider` and `LauncherAppsProvider`; the auth state is a store moved the way `AuthProvider` moves it, and `ConnectedShell` is reduced to its one effect on this order (nothing renders below it until the test says the adapter connected). Cases: the session names the organization, so the request leaves while `organization/list` and `discovery` are both unanswered, the page and `/me/apps` still wait for the list, and in the end there is one permissions request and no duplicate URL; an app route, with the list answering before the shell; control: a session naming no organization asks nothing until the pipeline chose one; control: a session with no active organization is redirected to `/organizations` with zero permissions requests.
- New `ui/packages/permissions/src/__tests__/MePermissionsProvider.heldRequest-29114.test.tsx` (9 tests): same endpoint and key, the held request is the answer and the provider asks nothing; starting twice asks once; used once (a second provider asks for itself); another key asks and drops the held request; no key asks as before; a released request is not taken; a replayed starter asks once; a StrictMode provider uses the held request and asks nothing; a transient failure of the held request is retried by the provider.

- Five existing console tests that replace `../AppContent` with a mock (`App.agentChatLink-10640`, `App.docsPortalLazy`, `App.nativeShellMode-29039`, `i18nAfterSignIn-12034`, `internalFormShell`) name the new `ConsolePermissionsRequest` export as `() => null`, one line each; without it vitest refuses the missing mock export.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed by anchor count and blob hash, restored byte-identical to HEAD, under `os-verify-lock`):

- `<ConsolePermissionsRequest />` removed from the layout route: 2 red (both early-request cases), the two controls stay green.
- the provider ignores the held request (`const held = null`): 5 red (2 app, 3 provider).

## Acceptance notes

- **Measurement, production build** (`vite build` of the Console at origin/main 87d6baef and at this branch, each served by `vite preview` proxying to `examples/app-crm` under `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`; Chromium; three full-page opens of `/home` each; resource timing; the session names `activeOrganizationId`):

  | leg | perm start − `organization/list` start | API requests | duplicate URLs |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | origin/main | +87 / +66 / +58 ms (after the list answered) | 20 / 19 / 19 | 0 |
  | this branch | −8 / −11 / −12 ms | 20 / 19 / 19 | 0 |

  On the Vite dev server (StrictMode doubles effects on both legs): origin/main +147 / +295 / +200 ms with two permissions requests per open; this branch −17 / −22 / −25 ms with one.
- **The first design was measured and dropped.** Owning the organization gate in `ConsolePermissionsScope` (`requireOrganization={false}` on the route) only moved the request from after `organization/list` to after `/discovery` (+51 / +66 / +60 ms on the dev server, `discovery` 10547→10558 then permissions 10602 beside `meta/app` 10610). The surface amendment on the card records the switch.
- **Known cost:** a session whose active organization the organization list does not confirm (a stale session) sends one permissions request nobody reads, then redirects to `/organizations` as before.
- **The early request carries the same `X-Tenant-ID` as the other requests of that wave** (`organization/list`, `get-active-member`): whatever `ActiveOrganizationStorage` holds before the list answers. The framework scopes the answer from the session, not the header.
- **Lint:** `react-refresh/only-export-components` now warns twice on `MePermissionsProvider.tsx` (the two new non-component exports); warnings only, the file already exported non-component types. `AppContent.tsx` carries the same two warnings it had on main.
- `ui/packages/permissions/src/index.ts` (three export lines) is outside the claim's named file list; the exports are what the amendment declares.

## Verification

Head `d783ff15` (main merged after #29140 and again before opening; both merges clean, no parallel change to the touched files).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 34 commands, all exit 0 at `e37c383b` (the same 12 paths as the head); `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Full `apps/console` + `packages/permissions` vitest (297 files) at `e37c383b`: green after the five mock stubs (2908 tests). At the head: the App route-table tests, `i18nAfterSignIn-12034`, `internalFormShell`, `pages/settings` and the permissions package, 58 files / 482 tests green.
- `ui/scripts/` vitest: 169 files green. `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`: 0. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/permissions run type-check`: 0. eslint on every touched file: 0 errors, 4 warnings (see Acceptance notes).
- `pnpm build` (117 tasks) green after the first main merge.
